exposure: Acute severe migraine headache attack during pregnancy
acute severe migraine headache attack during pregnancy
cohort: 86 pregnant women who presented to the hospital with an acute severe migraine headache attack
finding: Pregnant women who sought treatment for acute migraine headache had a higher rate of preterm delivery, preeclampsia, and low birth weight compared to the local and general populations, while the rate of cesarean delivery was lower.
mod_finding: Pregnant women seeking treatment for acute migraine headache experienced a lower rate of cesarean delivery than the local and general populations.
